summary: Phase 5C Request Center Testing completed successfully. All 4 request types (Leave, Day Off, Pick Up Shift, Swap Shift) are working. Multi-step wizard flow, back navigation, Recent Requests display, and success screens all functioning correctly. Frontend: 100% pass rate.

frontend_flows: Request Center loads at /staff/requests with 4 request types: Leave Request, Request Day Off, Pick Up Shift, Swap Shift
Leave Request flow: Select Type -> Select Leave Type (7 options: annual, sick, unpaid, compassionate, maternity, paternity, other) -> Fill dates -> Confirm -> Submit -> Success
Leave type selection shows Annual Leave Balance display
Day Off Request flow: Click -> Fill date -> Confirm -> Submit -> Success with 'day off request' message
Pick Up Shift flow: Click -> Fill 'Date to Work' -> Confirm -> Submit -> Success with 'shift pick up request' message
Swap Shift flow: Click -> Select shift dropdown -> Choose swap type (Open Swap/Direct Request) -> Fill message -> Confirm
Recent Requests section shows past submissions with status badges (approved/pending)
New Request button on Kiosk Clock Screen [data-testid='new-request-btn'] navigates to /staff/requests
Back button [data-testid='back-btn'] navigates correctly: Leave form -> Leave subtype -> Main screen
Back button navigation: Day Off form -> Main screen (direct, no subtype)
Close button [data-testid='close-btn'] navigates back to /staff (Kiosk Clock Screen)
Success screen shows 'Request Submitted!' with 'New Request' and 'View My Requests' buttons
Breadcrumb navigation shows progress: Type -> [Leave Type] -> Details -> Confirm
Authentication protection: Direct URL /staff/requests redirects to login when not authenticated
